title: Morning Report | Robert Whittaker explains how Reinier de Ridder fight came together so quickly
text: Robert Whittaker is ready to step back into the cage, and it all happened very quickly. Over the weekend, the UFC announced that Whittaker will make his return to the octagon this summer when he takes on former ONE two-division champion Reinier de Ridder in the main event of UFC Abu Dhabi. It’s Whittaker’s first fight back since suffering a gruesome mouth injury against Khamzat Chimaev and it’s a bit of a surprising one, given the multiple opponents Whittaker was linked to beforehand. But Whittaker explained that the fight sort of fell together as a product of good timing. “I told my manager, ‘Speak to them. I’m looking for late June, early July. International Fight Week looks good, let’s get something,’” Whittaker explained on his YouTube channel. “And I was also kind of mentioning [Sean] Strickland at the time. We’re both up there, it makes sense, we’ve never fought, let’s get it done. “They came back to me and said, ‘Strickland is just getting back into training. We can try and get that fight to happen but we don’t know when it’s going to happen, but [Roman] Dolidze ... is ready and willing.’ I was like, done. Sign me up. Let’s go. ... “Then, literally four days ago, they’re like, ‘RDR? De Ridder, main event, Abu Dhabi, July 28.’ I was like, what happened to the other one? [Laughs]. I don’t know what happened to anything.” Of course, that didn’t stop Whittaker from accepting. Earlier this month, de Ridder became the first man to defeat Bo Nickal, stopping him in the co-main event of UFC Des Moines. Though that win didn’t elevate “RDR” in the rankings, it did boost de Ridder’s profile significantly, and made this an easy “yes” for Whittaker. “All I know is the date fit,” Whittaker said. “He’s not in the top 10 yet but he just beat Bo Nickal. He’s a good hard fight, he had two titles in ONE, he’s a hard fight. I’m sure he’ll be in the top 10 before long. He’s a top 10 fighter, competitor at least. That’s a hard fight, let’s do it. July is a good time, so I just said yes, straight away. ... “Everything kind of worked out. We’re 11 weeks from Abu Dhabi, main event, five rounds. It’s always fun. I love my face on a poster, the kids love it. I look forward to getting work done.” For Whittaker, de Ridder presents a opportunity to rebound from his brutal loss to Chimaev and re-insert himself as a going concern at 185 pounds. And at 34 years old, “The Reaper” knows he doesn’t have much time left to accomplish the things he wants to do in MMA. “I’m looking forward to it,” Whittaker said. “I want to get back in there and I want to get back in that winning column. I’ve got some things — I don’t want to fight forever. I’ve got a couple years left in my career and I want that fairytale ending. Especially after seeing Volk, and now JDM get up, I want that fairytale ending. That’s where — I want to work my way up to the title, win the belt, and sail off into the sunset. That’s the dream I’m pushing and fighting for right now.” UFC Abu Dhabi takes place July 26 at Etihad Arena. title: Former champ Whittaker to face de Ridder in July
text: Former middleweight champion Robert Whittaker will look to rebound from a high-profile loss in his most recent appearance when he headlines UFC Fight Night on July 26 against Reinier de Ridder. UFC officials announced the 185-pound bout Saturday. The UFC Fight Night will take place at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Whittaker (26-8) is coming off a first-round submission loss to Khamzat Chimaev in October. He said he suffered from teeth displacement in the loss, after Chimaev secured an early face crank after an immediate takedown. Whittaker, 34, had been approaching title contention prior to the loss, with victories over Paulo Costa and Ikram Aliskerov. De Ridder (20-2), who goes by the nickname "RDR," is coming off the biggest win of his career in a second-round knockout of Bo Nickal last weekend. The Dutch contender is 3-0 since signing with the UFC last year, compiling those three victories in a span of less than six months. Middleweight champion Dricus Du Plessis does not have his next title defense set, but the UFC has already announced he will face Chimaev on a date to be determined.

title: Reinier De Ridder Thinks He Chokes Out Robert Whittaker
text: Robert Whittaker Is getting Choked Out Early by Reinier de Ridder In UFC Headliner, According to Middleweight Star Former two-division ONE MMA champion Reinier De Ridder is confident that he will defeat former UFC middleweight champion in their headline fight at UFC on ABC: Whittaker vs. De Ridder. With the UFC dominating the MMA market, despite strong competitors in the PFL, many fans tend to overlook or even look down on those who seek a career outside of the UFC, as Reinier De Ridder did during the peak of ONE Championship MMA. Now that he’s in the UFC, he’s soundly defeated notable names such as veteran Gerald Meerschaert, Kevin Holland, and a highly hyped prospect in Bo Nickal. Now he jumps to an even higher height as he looks to take down the former UFC champion and perennial contender in Robert Whittaker.

title: Robert Whittaker Previews Exciting UFC Abu Dhabi Fight Against Reinier De Ridder
text: Robert Whittaker previews exciting UFC Abu Dhabi fight against Reinier de Ridder UFC star Robert Whittaker is ready to try and bounce back from his loss to Khamzat Chimaev when he battles Reinier de Ridder on Saturday night. As we know, Robert Whittaker is one of the greatest middleweights to ever compete in the Ultimate Fighting Championship. He’s beaten a wide array of top names throughout the course of his time in the division, and he’s also held the title. However, after losing to Khamzat Chimaev in convincing fashion in his last outing, it certainly feels like Robert Whittaker’s back is against the wall. This weekend, he’ll try and prove himself once again when facing Reinier de Ridder, who is riding a big wave of momentum right now. In a recent interview, Robert Whittaker opened up on this fight and how important it is for him. Robert Whittaker looks ahead to Reinier de Ridder fight “The middleweight division over the next few is just moving now,” Whittaker told MMA Junkie on Tuesday. “I feel like it was all kind of still for a little bit, but now everything’s moving. There are some big fights on the way.” “I want to bounce back,” said Whittaker, who hasn’t lost two fights in a row since his welterweight days in 2013-2014. “After losing, I’ve always gotten better and come back with a win. It’s important for me to do that again to move toward the direction I want to go, which is that title.” “It’s hard to explain, going to take forever to go through,” Whittaker said. “It’s hard. It’s a bigger thing to unpack. I don’t know. It is what it is. Sometimes you win, sometimes you lose.” “He’s very good at taking the fight where you’re uncomfortable,” Whittaker said. “He’s got a particular set of skills and a particular game plan that, if he executes well, he gives you a lot of problems. Bo found that out the hard way. I’m looking to be first and take the game where I’m strong. … “I love being aggressive. I’m a striker by heart, so I want to try and get my mitts on him.” Quotes via MMA Junkie

title: Robert Whittaker vs. Reinier de Ridder Tops UFC Abu Dhabi in July
text: Reinier de Ridder is wasting no time making his way up the UFC middleweight division. The former ONE Championship double-champ, fresh off a win over Bo Nickal a week ago, has already booked his return. He’ll headline UFC Abu Dhabi on July 26 at the Etihad Arena, taking on former 185lb champ Robert Whittaker. UFC officials announced the booking on Saturday. For de Ridder (20-2), it will mark his fifth fight in a year, and fourth fight under the UFC banner since November 2024, an impressive pace to say the least. “The Dutch Knight,” who lost back-to-back fights against Anatoly Malykhin to close out his ONE Championship career, bemoaned the lack of activity in that promotion, warning other fighters against signing there. RDR has not had the same difficulty finding fights in the UFC however. He debuted opposite Gerald Meerschaert, submitting the veteran, then put away Kevin Holland with a rear-naked choke back in January. The Nickal fight, however, which served as the UFC Des Moines co-main event, really turned heads. Reinier de Ridder finished that one on the feet, setting up the finish with some nasty knees to the body- earning a Performance of the Night bonus in the process. Robert Whittaker (26-8) has not competed since suffering a nasty loss at the hands of Khamzat Chimeav last October. That left “The Reaper” with some serious damage to his jaw area. The Australian former champ had been on a two-fight win streak prior to that setback, having defeated Paulo Costa and Ikram Aliskerov. Whittaker is ranked #5 in the middleweight division, while Reinier de Ridder sits at #13.

title: Reinier de Ridder krijgt UFC hoofdgevecht - grootste test tot nu toe!
text: Reinier de Ridder krijgt UFC hoofdgevecht - grootste test tot nu toe! Het is officieel: Reinier de Ridder vecht op 26 juli in Abu Dhabi tegen voormalig UFC-kampioen Robert Whittaker. Een knalpartij, en een dikke beloning voor De Ridder, die in de UFC al meerdere keren liet zien dat hij daar thuishoort. Deze keer staat hij in het main event. Tegen een grote naam. Tegen iemand die jarenlang aan de top stond in het middengewicht. En Reinier? Die is er klaar voor. Lees ook 'Ik maak hem af!' Zo gaat Reinier de Ridder UFC badboy Khamzat Chimaev slopen UFC terug naar Nederland nu Reinier de Ridder blijft winnen - Ahoy of de ArenA? De Ridder wil bewijzen dat hij niet alleen meedoet, maar ook echt de top aankan De Ridder staat bekend als een slimme vechter. Technisch sterk, gevaarlijk op de grond, en mentaal ijzersterk. In zijn eerdere UFC-gevechten liet hij zien dat hij kan winnen op zijn manier: met controle, slimme keuzes en een duidelijke gameplan. Maar Whittaker is een ander verhaal. Hij is snel, explosief en heeft veel ervaring in vijfronders. Toch weet Reinier wat hij moet doen. Zijn stijl is lastig te doorgronden, zeker als hij je naar de grond krijgt. Abu Dhabi is opnieuw het podium voor een grote UFC-avond De UFC houdt van grote evenementen in Abu Dhabi. De sfeer, het publiek, de locatie — het klopt altijd. En met De Ridder vs. Whittaker bovenaan de kaart belooft dit een show te worden. Voor Reinier is dit het moment. Hij heeft gevochten, gewonnen, geleerd. Nu wil hij laten zien dat hij ook vechters als Whittaker aankan. Wint hij deze? Dan zit hij meteen dichtbij een titelgevecht. He’s beaten a wide array of top names throughout the course of his time in the division, and he’s also held the title. However, after losing to Khamzat Chimaev in convincing fashion in his last outing, it certainly feels like Robert Whittaker’s back is against the wall. This weekend, he’ll try and prove himself once again when facing Reinier de Ridder, who is riding a big wave of momentum right now. In a recent interview, Robert Whittaker opened up on this fight and how important it is for him. Robert Whittaker looks ahead to Reinier de Ridder fight “The middleweight division over the next few is just moving now,” Whittaker told MMA Junkie on Tuesday. “I feel like it was all kind of still for a little bit, but now everything’s moving. There are some big fights on the way.” “I want to bounce back,” said Whittaker, who hasn’t lost two fights in a row since his welterweight days in 2013-2014. “After losing, I’ve always gotten better and come back with a win. It’s important for me to do that again to move toward the direction I want to go, which is that title.” “It’s hard to explain, going to take forever to go through,” Whittaker said. “It’s hard. It’s a bigger thing to unpack. I don’t know. It is what it is. Sometimes you win, sometimes you lose.” “He’s very good at taking the fight where you’re uncomfortable,” Whittaker said. “He’s got a particular set of skills and a particular game plan that, if he executes well, he gives you a lot of problems. Bo found that out the hard way. I’m looking to be first and take the game where I’m strong. … “I love being aggressive. I’m a striker by heart, so I want to try and get my mitts on him.” Quotes via MMA Junkie

title: Robert Whittaker vs. Reinier de Ridder Tops UFC Abu Dhabi in July
text: Reinier de Ridder is wasting no time making his way up the UFC middleweight division. The former ONE Championship double-champ, fresh off a win over Bo Nickal a week ago, has already booked his return. He’ll headline UFC Abu Dhabi on July 26 at the Etihad Arena, taking on former 185lb champ Robert Whittaker. UFC officials announced the booking on Saturday. For de Ridder (20-2), it will mark his fifth fight in a year, and fourth fight under the UFC banner since November 2024, an impressive pace to say the least. “The Dutch Knight,” who lost back-to-back fights against Anatoly Malykhin to close out his ONE Championship career, bemoaned the lack of activity in that promotion, warning other fighters against signing there. RDR has not had the same difficulty finding fights in the UFC however. He debuted opposite Gerald Meerschaert, submitting the veteran, then put away Kevin Holland with a rear-naked choke back in January. The Nickal fight, however, which served as the UFC Des Moines co-main event, really turned heads. Reinier de Ridder finished that one on the feet, setting up the finish with some nasty knees to the body- earning a Performance of the Night bonus in the process. Robert Whittaker (26-8) has not competed since suffering a nasty loss at the hands of Khamzat Chimeav last October. That left “The Reaper” with some serious damage to his jaw area. The Australian former champ had been on a two-fight win streak prior to that setback, having defeated Paulo Costa and Ikram Aliskerov. Whittaker is ranked #5 in the middleweight division, while Reinier de Ridder sits at #13.

title: Reinier de Ridder krijgt UFC hoofdgevecht - grootste test tot nu toe!
text: Reinier de Ridder krijgt UFC hoofdgevecht - grootste test tot nu toe! Het is officieel: Reinier de Ridder vecht op 26 juli in Abu Dhabi tegen voormalig UFC-kampioen Robert Whittaker. Een knalpartij, en een dikke beloning voor De Ridder, die in de UFC al meerdere keren liet zien dat hij daar thuishoort. Deze keer staat hij in het main event. Tegen een grote naam. Tegen iemand die jarenlang aan de top stond in het middengewicht. En Reinier? Die is er klaar voor. Lees ook 'Ik maak hem af!' Zo gaat Reinier de Ridder UFC badboy Khamzat Chimaev slopen UFC terug naar Nederland nu Reinier de Ridder blijft winnen - Ahoy of de ArenA? De Ridder wil bewijzen dat hij niet alleen meedoet, maar ook echt de top aankan De Ridder staat bekend als een slimme vechter. Technisch sterk, gevaarlijk op de grond, en mentaal ijzersterk. In zijn eerdere UFC-gevechten liet hij zien dat hij kan winnen op zijn manier: met controle, slimme keuzes en een duidelijke gameplan. Maar Whittaker is een ander verhaal. Hij is snel, explosief en heeft veel ervaring in vijfronders. Toch weet Reinier wat hij moet doen. Zijn stijl is lastig te doorgronden, zeker als hij je naar de grond krijgt. Abu Dhabi is opnieuw het podium voor een grote UFC-avond De UFC houdt van grote evenementen in Abu Dhabi. De sfeer, het publiek, de locatie — het klopt altijd. En met De Ridder vs. Whittaker bovenaan de kaart belooft dit een show te worden. Voor Reinier is dit het moment. Hij heeft gevochten, gewonnen, geleerd. Nu wil hij laten zien dat hij ook vechters als Whittaker aankan. Wint hij deze? Dan zit hij meteen dichtbij een titelgevecht. text: Alles wat je moet weten van UFC Fight Night: Whittaker vs. De Ridder DoorMarcel Dorff Reinier de Ridder gaat op 26 juli voor zijn vierde overwinning in acht maanden tijd. De Nederlander vecht het hoofdgevecht van UFC Fight Night: Abu Dhabi tegen ex-kampioen Robert Whittaker in het middengewicht. Voor de Ridder is het een hele grote stap in de divisie. Een overwinning op Whittaker kan de Nederlander een ranking in de top 5 van het middengewicht opleveren. Het gevecht werd bekend gemaakt door de UFC via sociale media. Main Event Reinier de Ridder vecht pas sinds november vorig jaar in de UFC, maar heeft nu al een onuitwisbare indruk gemaakt. De Nederlander won zijn eerste twee partijen van Gerald Meerschaert en Kevin Holland en kwam vervolgens al de rankings in. De Ridder vocht vervolgens eerder deze maand in Des Moines tegen het ongeslagen worstelfenomeen Bo Nickal. De Ridder overklaste de Amerikaan en won via TKO in de tweede ronde. Die overwinning levert hem nu een gevecht op tegen een van de meest gearriveerde vechters in de divisie en voormalig kampioen Robert Whittaker. De sympathieke Australiër was tussen 2017 en 2019 de te kloppen man binnen de organisatie. Whittaker verloor uiteindelijk zijn titel aan Israel Adesanya. Whittaker vocht in 2024 liefst driemaal. Hij won via knock-out van Ikram Aliskerov en leek met een nieuwe overwinning op Paulo Costa weer richting een titelgevecht te vechten. Echter ging Whittaker in zijn meest recente partij vrij kansloos onderuit tegen Khamzat Chimaev en moet hij tegen de Ridder zijn plek in de top 5 van de divisie zien te verdedigen. In the co-main event, undefeated featherweight contender Movsar Evloev faces off against UFC newcomer Aaron Pico in a potential 145-pound title eliminator. Pico, a former Bellator star with a 13-4 record, brings raw talent and knockout power to his Octagon debut. Also on the card is the return of former bantamweight champion Petr Yan, who takes on rising star Marcus McGhee. Yan is in strong form after back-to-back victories over Song Yadong and Deiveson Figueiredo in 2024. This marks the 21st UFC event held in Abu Dhabi since 2010, solidifying the city’s position as a global hub for MMA. With high stakes, top contenders, and fierce rivalries, UFC Fight Night: Abu Dhabi promises fireworks. title: Reinier de Ridder vecht eerste UFC Main Event tegen ex-kampioen Robert Whittaker in Abu Dhabi
text: Alles wat je moet weten van UFC Fight Night: Whittaker vs. De Ridder DoorMarcel Dorff Reinier de Ridder gaat op 26 juli voor zijn vierde overwinning in acht maanden tijd. De Nederlander vecht het hoofdgevecht van UFC Fight Night: Abu Dhabi tegen ex-kampioen Robert Whittaker in het middengewicht. Voor de Ridder is het een hele grote stap in de divisie. Een overwinning op Whittaker kan de Nederlander een ranking in de top 5 van het middengewicht opleveren. Het gevecht werd bekend gemaakt door de UFC via sociale media. Main Event Reinier de Ridder vecht pas sinds november vorig jaar in de UFC, maar heeft nu al een onuitwisbare indruk gemaakt. De Nederlander won zijn eerste twee partijen van Gerald Meerschaert en Kevin Holland en kwam vervolgens al de rankings in. De Ridder vocht vervolgens eerder deze maand in Des Moines tegen het ongeslagen worstelfenomeen Bo Nickal. De Ridder overklaste de Amerikaan en won via TKO in de tweede ronde. Die overwinning levert hem nu een gevecht op tegen een van de meest gearriveerde vechters in de divisie en voormalig kampioen Robert Whittaker. De sympathieke Australiër was tussen 2017 en 2019 de te kloppen man binnen de organisatie. Whittaker verloor uiteindelijk zijn titel aan Israel Adesanya. Whittaker vocht in 2024 liefst driemaal. Hij won via knock-out van Ikram Aliskerov en leek met een nieuwe overwinning op Paulo Costa weer richting een titelgevecht te vechten. Echter ging Whittaker in zijn meest recente partij vrij kansloos onderuit tegen Khamzat Chimaev en moet hij tegen de Ridder zijn plek in de top 5 van de divisie zien te verdedigen. title: Robert Whittaker vs. Reinier de Ridder set to headline UFC Abu Dhabi
text: Robert Whittaker is back. The UFC announced on Saturday that the former middleweight champ faces Reinier de Ridder in the main event of UFC Abu Dhabi. The No. 7 ranked middleweight in MMA Fighting’s Global Rankings had his hand raised in three of his past five outings. De Ridder remains incredibly active since joining the UFC roster. The former ONE two-division champion is 3-0 inside the octagon, stopping Gerald Meerschaert, Kevin Holland, and — most recently at UFC Des Moines earlier this month — Bo Nickal.
